tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: Resolve DNS records for a domain (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, CAA) and identify its DNS host and email provider. Price: $0.001 per call.

tools.name: security_headers
tools.description: Grade a website's HTTP security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy and more) A-F, list what is missing, and flag exposed server version info. Price: $0.001 per call.

tools.name: domain_whois
tools.description: Look up who registered a domain and when: registrar, creation and expiry dates, domain age, status codes, nameservers and DNSSEC, via RDAP (the modern WHOIS). Price: $0.002 per call.

tools.name: email_security
tools.description: Audit a domain's email security: SPF, DMARC policy, DKIM keys, MX/email provider, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT and BIMI, with an A-F grade, a spoofability verdict and plain-English issues. Price: $0.002 per call.

tools.name: site_metadata
tools.description: Extract a website's title, description, language, social profiles, public contact emails and phones, key pages (contact, pricing, careers, docs), RSS feeds and schema.org organization data. Price: $0.002 per call.

tools.name: page_to_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a web page and return its main content as clean Markdown (navigation, ads, scripts and cookie banners removed), ready for an LLM to read. Price: $0.002 per call.

tools.name: ssl_certificates
tools.description: Check a domain's TLS certificates from Certificate Transparency logs: current certificate, issuer, days until expiry, and every subdomain that has appeared on a certificate. Price: $0.003 per call.

tools.name: tech_stack
tools.description: Detect what a website is built with: framework, CMS or site builder, hosting/CDN, web server, analytics, ad pixels, payments, chat, auth and more (90+ technologies), with the evidence for each. Price: $0.003 per call.

tools.name: company_profile
tools.description: Build a company profile from just a domain: name, description, logo, location, social profiles, public contact info, domain age, email and hosting providers, key tech stack, and business signals (takes payments, hiring, runs ads...). One call instead of six. Price: $0.01 per call.

tools.name: domain_report
tools.description: Everything about a domain in one call: DNS, registration, certificates and subdomains, email security grade, HTTP security headers grade, tech stack and website metadata, plus an overall summary. Price: $0.02 per call.

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: List every tool with its price per call and the accepted payment methods. Free.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Create an AIPayGen API key with $0.05 of free trial credits. Free. Store the key: it is shown only once.

tools.name: account_balance
tools.description: Show the remaining credit balance of the API key sent with this request. Free.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "page_to_markdown" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Fetch a web page and return its main content as clean Markdown (navigation, ads, scripts and cookie banners removed), ready for an LLM to read. Price: $0.002 pe…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: page_to_markdown · Private data: dns_lookup, site_metadata, company_profile, create_api_key, account_balance · Public sink: dns_lookup, email_security, company_profile, domain_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: page_to_markdown · Private data: dns_lookup, site_metadata, company_profile, create_api_key, account_balance · Public sink: dns_lookup, email_security, company_profile, domain_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
